mentions.name: Unified widgets
mentions.description: A unified widgets framework where GUIs are described once in a single format and run anywhere — oldschool desktop GUIs as well as web GUIs — in any programming language. It is being prototyped primarily in Ruby, with Python and Java planned next, and the end format is meant to let normal people describe everything in one format that becomes the basis for every GUI.
mentions.source_excerpt: continue on the unified widgets project (e. g. use oldschool GUIs but also for the web "GUIs"). Describe once, run anywhere, in any programming language. This is obviously way too much for a single person, so I mostly want to get the foundation right, prototype primarily in ruby, then add python and java to it. The "end format" should be for normal people, e. g. they should be able to describe everything in one format, and then have that be the basis for every GUI.
